## EcclesiaOS v1.0.60

### Reusable section editor improvements

- Redesigned the edit-section screen to match the full-width branded create workflow.
- Restored visible section appearance controls for backgrounds, dimensions, images, and videos.
- Made background image and video upload controls respond to the width of each builder column.
- Prevented page-level file input styles from stretching and clipping nested builder controls.
- Displayed selected filenames cleanly in the media control heading.
- Added regression coverage for both editor layouts and responsive media controls.
